newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in ASML jump after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Shares in ASML jump after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Dutch semiconductor equipment maker ASM Lithography jumped in Amsterdam on Wednesday after the company reported higher-than-expected 1997 first-half results.

ASML shares were up 18.20 guilders, 11.25 percent, at 180.00 guilders in early trade on the Amsterdam stock exchange. The stock has been in heavy demand recently and has risen from a low of 72.50 guilders recorded in April this year.
ASM Litho, in which Philips Electronics holds a 24 percent stake, said first-half net profit rose to 147 million guilders from 101 million in the same period of 1996.
After stripping out 31 million guilders of extraordinary income from the sale of a stake in a supplier, earnings were still above analysts' forecasts of 95 to 105 million guilders.
"The results were really good, even without the one-off gains, and the forecast looks comforting," a dealer said. "This should be good for the shares, which are already hard to get hold of."
The AEX share index jumped through the 1,000 point level for the first time at the open, and was trading up 3.34 percent at 0738 GMT.
